close_reason: Closed by the same commit as PKIX-7f92.5 — both bounds of the max-octets parameter and both API paths (with_max_octets, set_parameter) now route through a shared validate_max_octets helper enforcing 1..=21. with_max_octets panics on out-of-range; set_parameter returns ParameterError::InvalidValue. with_max_octets_zero_panics + with_max_octets_above_21_panics regression tests lock the panic shape.
title: Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint::with_max_octets(0) silently constructs a lint that rejects every cert; set_parameter rejects 0 with InvalidValue — the two parameter paths have opposite validation semantics
